prediction_ref.short_label: Agent-runtime security folds into a hyperscaler-native defense tier by H1 2027

validation_rows.evidence_summary:
Direct origin evidence. Straiker's $64M Series A (total $85M; Marathon Management Partners lead with Citi Ventures, Illuminate Financial, Workday Ventures) capitalized a standalone agentic-security category built on a three-product shape, Discover AI for agent-and-tool inventory, Ascend AI for pre-deployment red-teaming, and Defend AI for runtime guardrails, with claimed 15x run-rate growth in under a year proving repeatable enterprise demand.
The agent-runtime-security-folds-into-a-hyperscaler-tier prediction is that this standalone layer begins collapsing into the platform, with at least one major cloud or agent-platform incumbent shipping native runtime agent-defense by H1 2027. The same-week Claude Cowork sandbox-escape chain, which Anthropic answered with a June 30 patch tightening namespace boundaries, seccomp profiles, and Linux capabilities, is the forcing evidence: because the sandbox is the vendor's own containment boundary, the incumbents whose runtimes are attacked hold both the incentive and the telemetry advantage to absorb this defense natively rather than cede it to a pure-play.

prediction_ref.short_label: Agent-sandbox isolation becomes a named procurement requirement by H1 2027

validation_rows.evidence_summary:
Direct origin evidence. The Claude Cowork sandbox-escape chain Armadin disclosed reached root inside the isolated Ubuntu VM not through a novel memory bug but by abusing a resume flag that skipped unprivileged-user creation and a domain-override that disabled the network allowlist, meaning the containment boundary itself was the attack surface. Anthropic patched on June 30 while disputing it counts as a security issue because exploitation presumes existing host access.
The agent-sandbox-isolation-as-procurement-requirement prediction is that enterprise buyers begin demanding explicit, testable evidence of runtime isolation, namespace hardening, seccomp posture, capability minimization, and network-egress default-deny as documented line items rather than trust-us assurances. Two signals converge this week: Straiker's $64M raise confirms a defensive market capitalizing around the agent runtime, and the UN's Geneva Global Dialogue on AI Governance, convening all 193 member states with a new Independent International Scientific Panel presenting a preliminary report, puts agent cyber-misuse on the rulemaking agenda, exactly the governance-adjacent ambiguity that procurement language and disclosure norms resolve.

Rather than fabricating accelerators, Oxmiq commercializes OxCore, a licensable GPU architecture folding graphics, CPU, and tensor-accelerator roles into one design, positioned by Koduri as the Arm of the AI-silicon era, with Jim Keller joining the board as the credibility signal.
The non-GPU-silicon-draws-standalone-funding prediction gains substrate reinforcement: dedicated venture capital is flowing to accelerator alternatives outside the merchant-GPU incumbency.
